notes: New-generation power unit: roughly 50/50 electric/combustion split and no MGU-H, but the ICE stays a 1.6L V6 turbo - modeled here with a redline slightly higher than the frozen 2022-2025 spec (see f1-2022.json onward). The MGU-K's regulated output nearly triples (120kW -> 350kW) to carry that heavier electric share, with a 500Nm mechanical torque limit per the FIA's 2026 PU regulations. New-generation cars are also mandated smaller and lighter than the 2022-2025 ground-effect era, reflected in the lower chassis weight here. maxRevRpm stays at the same 15,000rpm FIA hard limit that's applied across every season here (see realCars.ts).
